2610.08937.title: A Shortcut to Structure in AlphaFold 3
2610.08937.paper_summary: AlphaFold 3 predicts protein structures with remarkable accuracy, yet how structural information emerges within the model remains poorly understood. Here, through causal interventions on internal representations and direct probing of every Pairformer block, we trace the formation of global protein geometry and identify the multiple sequence alignment (MSA) as a structural shortcut to the fold. Removing the MSA largely preserves local secondary structure while disrupting the long-range relationships that define global topology. Restoring the MSA-enriched pair representation at only forty residues recovers most of this lost organization, including at pairs never directly modified. This contribution depends on the detailed direction of the MSA module's output rather than its magnitude. The Pairformer rapidly converts this signal into global geometry: the final fold becomes recoverable by approximately block 9 of 48 for a majority of proteins, roughly twenty-seven blocks before the model's decoder can render it, whereas without the MSA it remains inaccessible for most proteins throughout the pass. Which homologs are supplied shapes this trajectory more strongly than which query is supplied; it persists for a designed query that never evolved but collapses for a shuffled sequence. Most importantly, an alignment built for a different protein that shares the fold, supplied only at the structurally corresponding columns, raises the median TM-score against experiment from 0.44 to 0.72, while the same alignment shifted a few residues along the chain performs worse than supplying no alignment at all. What AlphaFold 3 reads from an alignment is therefore a description of the fold itself, transferable between proteins that share one, rather than the query's own evolutionary history. This explains both its accuracy and the limits of what it has solved.
2610.08937.paper_summary_zh: AlphaFold 3 以驚人的準確度預測蛋白質結構，但模型內部如何產生結構信息仍然不甚了解。<lb/>在這裡，通過對內部表徵的因果干預和對每個 Pairformer 模塊的直接探測，我們追踪全球蛋白質幾何形狀的形成，並將多序列比對 (MSA) 確定為結構性捷徑。<lb/>去除 MSA 在很大程度上保留了局部二級結構，同時破壞了定義全球拓撲的長距離關係。<lb/>在僅四十個殘基處恢復豐富 MSA 的配對表徵，能夠恢復大部分失去的組織，包括在從未直接修改的配對中。<lb/>這一貢獻依賴於 MSA 模塊輸出的詳細方向，而非其大小。<lb/>Pairformer 快速將這一信號轉換為全球幾何形狀：對於大多數蛋白質，最終的摺疊在大約第 48 個模塊的第 9 個區塊就能被恢復，這大約比模型的解碼器能夠呈現的早二十七個區塊，而沒有 MSA 則在整個過程中對大多數蛋白質仍然無法訪問。<lb/>供應的同源物比供應的查詢更強烈地塑造了這一軌跡；它在一個從未進化的設計查詢中持續存在，但在隨機打亂的序列中則崩潰。<lb/>最重要的是，為另一個共享摺疊的不同蛋白質構建的比對，只在結構上對應的列中供應，將對實驗的中位 TM 分數從 0.44 提高到 0.72，而同樣的比對如果沿著鏈移動幾個殘基則表現不如完全不供應比對。<lb/>因此，AlphaFold 3 從比對中讀取的內容實際上是摺疊本身的描述，這種描述可以在共享摺疊的蛋白質之間轉移，而不是查詢自身的進化歷史。<lb/>這解釋了它的準確性以及它所解決問題的局限性。
